purpose: Adds a default-model picker, temperature/max-tokens generation defaults, and a credential-blind Test Connection button to the DuoPort Connector settings.
riskRationale: Changes are additive, fail-open, and credential-blind; phpunit (46 tests) and phpcs both pass, and no connectors_ai_* values are read.

text: Well-structured, defensively-guarded PR that keeps the repo hard rules (no setting aliasing, no connectors_ai_* value reads — verified by source scan). Verdict mapping is extracted into a pure testable helper and request mutation is caller-wins/fail-open. Remaining findings are all minor edge cases and one dead-code block.

message: AJAX handler checks manage_options capability and a nonce before doing anything, and error paths leak no key material (generic verdict strings only).

Settings render escapes all dynamic output (esc_attr/esc_html/esc_js/esc_url, checked()/selected()) and the inline script uses textContent rather than innerHTML, so server verdict messages cannot become stored XSS.
Verdict mapping extracted into pure static map_verdict() makes the 2xx/429/401-CreditsError contract unit-testable without HTTP, and matches the repo availability convention.
Generation-default injection is fail-open and caller-wins, wrapped in class_exists/method_exists guards plus try/catch, so requests can never fatal due to settings.

Lock contention returns VERDICT_NETWORK_ERROR, conflating 'another probe in flight' with a real network failure. Under concurrent Test-button clicks users can see a spurious 'network error' for a healthy key.
suggestion: Return the legacy cached bool verdict when locked, or a distinct stale/pending signal, instead of network_error.

message: Dead code: $wp_version_ok is computed (lines 482-489) and then immediately unset without ever being read, adding noise to render().

merge_generation_defaults() docblock says non-array input is returned 'unchanged', but the code returns array() for non-arrays (the ternary on line 108 is also redundant since is_array was just checked). Callers are currently guarded, so no live bug, but the contract misleads future reuse.
suggestion: Make the early return match the docblock (return $data) or fix the docblock to say array().

message: sanitize_max_tokens() applies absint/abs before clamping, so a negative input like -5 becomes 5 instead of the floor 1. Silently accepting sign-flipped values is surprising for a limit field.
suggestion: Cast to int first and clamp negatives to 1 instead of taking abs().

message: Default-model fill only triggers when the caller key is missing or '' — a caller-supplied null/false model id passes through unfilled and may reach the API as-is. Temperature/max_tokens similarly ignore '' caller values. Narrow edge case since SDK callers normally omit keys.
suggestion: Treat null (and false) like missing for model/temperature/max_tokens gap-filling.

message: Nonce fallback path verifies sanitize_key($_REQUEST['nonce']) without wp_unslash() first. Nonces are alphanumeric so impact is nil in practice, but slashed input would fail verification inconsistently with the primary check_ajax_referer path.
suggestion: Unslash before verifying in the fallback, mirroring the catalog handling below.
suggestionCode:
$nonce_raw = isset( $_REQUEST['nonce'] ) ? wp_unslash( $_REQUEST['nonce'] ) : '';
$nonce_ok = is_string( $nonce_raw ) && (bool) wp_verify_nonce( sanitize_key( $nonce_raw ), self::NONCE_ACTION );

message: Every chat/completions request now calls stored_options() → get_option() plus array_merge on the hot path. get_option() is object-cache backed so cost is negligible, but it is still per-request I/O-shaped work for data that rarely changes.
suggestion: Acceptable as-is; only revisit (static request-lifetime memo) if profiling shows it matters.

message: Unrecognized catalog values silently coerce to 'all', probing both catalogs (two network round-trips) on garbage input instead of rejecting the request. Fail-open and harmless, but wasteful and masks client bugs.
suggestion: Return a bad_request error for values outside go/zen/all instead of defaulting to all.

reasoning: All four specialized subagents (security, performance, quality, logic) failed to dispatch due to a provider free-tier restriction, so a direct single-pass review was performed instead: source files were read, connectors_ai_* blindness verified by scan, and phpunit (46 tests/151 assertions) plus phpcs (exit 0) were executed. Only minor-severity findings remain (dead code, doc/edge-case nits, spurious lock verdict); no critical or important issues block merge.
